bootstrap.nesting: Average four latent paths per training seed/scenario before expected-utility inference. For realized utility also average four queries. Negative indicators are formed before those averages.
bootstrap.qualification: Conditional on the four recorded paths and query draws; five training seeds provide limited information about training variability. Pointwise intervals make no family-wise significance claim.
bootstrap.unit: Crossed training seed and scenario/value group; all conditions stay within their group. Shared resampling weights across every model comparison in a dataset.
